definition: The Iowa Exclusion Zone — thousands of square kilometers of former farmland now patrolled by autonomous Behemoth agricultural platforms that kill any human on sight. The most productive food source on the continent and the most dangerous place to set foot. Gleaner Brigades raid it for salvage and stolen grain; nobody lives there.
origin: Geographic — the U.S. state of Iowa, surrendered to autonomous agriculture when Ironclad Agrisystems deployed Behemoth platforms at scale
example: Nobody goes to Iowa and comes back the same. Most don't come back at all.
